name: Camping 101: Cooking
summary: Camping 101: Cooking teaches fledgling adventurers the essential art of starting a fire and preparing sustenance in the wild. Found across the starting settlements of both the Alliance and Horde, this lesson introduces the campfire as the core anchor for any makeshift outdoor campsite.

sections.title: The Hearth of the Wilderness
sections.body: To survive outside fortified walls, every traveler must know how to build a fire. Beyond boiling water and roasting meat, a basic campfire serves as the vital foundation for pitching a camp in uncharted terrain. Without an open flame to keep back the cold and dark, raising any proper shelter is impossible.

sections.title: From Embers to Encampments
sections.body: While apprentice cooks can only sustain a modest fire with minimal surroundings, mastering culinary arts unlocks the ability to kindle larger blazes capable of supporting more elaborate campsites. Furthermore, adventurers who branch out into other practical tradeskills discover ways to craft useful furnishings to complement their camps.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The quest directs new adventurers to seek out their local cooking trainer in nearby settlements, ensuring they learn basic cooking and how to light a campfire to anchor an outdoor campsite.

faq.q: Who offers this quest to travelers?
faq.answer: Various experienced wilderness guides and adventurers offer this training across both factions, including Eleanor Shackleton, Eric Brighthammer, Lyreena Duskblade, Sam Sarsaparilla, Brakk, Kaga Wildhoof, and Raan Wildwind.

faq.q: Where do Alliance players turn this in?
faq.answer: Alliance adventurers report to trainers such as Tomas in Goldshire, Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos, or Zarrin in Dolanaar, depending on their home territory.

faq.q: Where do Horde players turn this in?
faq.answer: Horde adventurers can complete the training with Cook Torka in Razor Hill, William Pickman in Brill, or Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: Can campsite size be expanded later?
faq.answer: Yes. As you increase your cooking skill, you can learn to light larger, more enduring fires that can support more camp furnishings in the wilderness.

faq.q: Can other professions contribute to camping?
faq.answer: Yes. While cooking provides the campfire that anchors the camp, other tradeskill trainers offer ways to craft practical furnishings for your site if you have practiced their crafts.

angles.text: Cooking is the literal spark of camping life, providing both the vital sustenance to recover strength and the central campfire required to pitch an outdoor bivouac.
Novices departing Northshire, Dun Morogh, or Teldrassil are guided to towns like Goldshire, Kharanos, and Dolanaar to learn self-reliance before braving the wilds.
Survival is second nature to the Horde, and young fighters in Durotar, Mulgore, and Tirisfal are pointed straight toward campfires in Razor Hill, Bloodhoof Village, and Brill.
